answer: The dipping room smells of tallow and smoke, and the chandler will not be hurried. Proof of chandler candle via wick dip tally is his proof: a candle the chandler dips only after 13 dips run even, each dip cooled by the chandler himself. The zenith is the warm tallow the wicks drink. The shale is the cool rack where the candles hang to set. The jetty is the rendered fat the shop buys by the barrel. A forger must dip 13 times even, cool 13 times and count 13 candles true, a day of dipping for candles that still gutter.
